questions.question: The alerting plan is marked complete but the escalation worker (am-t6) — which actually fires escalation steps for unacknowledged alerts — was never implemented. Also, there are pending items from the content deploy E2E and Gatus Lite plans. What would you like to tackle next?

options.label: Escalation worker + alert rule UI (Recommended)
options.description: Implement the AlertEscalationService background worker that executes escalation steps, plus alert rule editor UI with cooldown/escalation selectors. This completes the alerting maturity feature properly.

options.label: Content deploy E2E (c10)
options.description: Upload content, deploy to LAPITG001116 agent, verify Succeeded status end-to-end.

options.label: Gatus Lite experience (lite-t2 through lite-t6)
options.description: Lite navigation routes, AppShell branding, typed product API client, endpoint tests.

options.label: All three (plan it out)
options.description: Create a combined plan covering escalation worker, content E2E, and Gatus Lite.
